title: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon 2026 Review: Miri's 22nd-Edition Community Run
seo_title: 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon 2026 Review | Miri Sarawak
meta_description: The 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon 2026: October 25 at Dynasty Hotel Miri, Sarawak. A single-distance 21.1K charity run with registration open.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at Dynasty Hotel in Miri, Sarawak, this 22nd-edition charity half marathon is a single-distance 21.1K community run with registration open. Two decades of history in Malaysian Borneo's oil city.
verdict: The 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon has been running in Miri, Sarawak for over two decades — a remarkable achievement for a community charity race. A single-distance 21.1K format keeps it focused, and the Dynasty Hotel venue provides a practical race hub with parking and facilities. October in Miri is relatively dry (Sarawak's landas monsoon typically begins in November), offering reasonable running conditions. For runners in Sarawak or those wanting a Borneo charity half marathon with genuine community roots, this is a solid, bookable pick.

sections.heading: 22 Editions: Miri's Charity Institution
paragraphs: Twenty-two editions is an extraordinary run for a community charity race. The Dynasty Hotel serves as a practical, well-equipped race hub.
